layer_contract.export_canvas: All layers are full-size 1024x1536 PNGs with a shared top-left origin and true alpha.
layer_contract.face: Pure featureless head skin and continuous extended neck; natural jaw-to-neck transition, one subtle contour, no transparent wedge, baked hair, ears, clothes or collar. Five distinct jaw variants keep facial feature anchors fixed.
layer_contract.ear: Five natural proportionate ear pairs with modest variations, continuous root flesh overlapping cheek, muted color matched to head skin, no large flared ears.
layer_contract.feature_alpha: Brow, eye, nose and mouth PNGs contain only the named feature; surrounding skin is transparent.
layer_contract.hair: Front owns the complete ordinary scalp visible from the front: normal crown y140, forehead hairline y279, temples and cheek locks. It sits above head and clothes. Cheek locks may be short or extend from one/both sides of the face. Rear hair is complete behind face, ears, neck and clothes, with no holes or cutouts. Buns, knots, braids and ribbons belong to rear; only ornaments rise above the ordinary crown. Both independently selectable layers share 1024x1536 canvas and head anchors.
layer_contract.clothes: One layer owns the complete petite torso pose and robe, without hair or skin baked into it.
layer_contract.makeup: Female alternative to the beard slot; option zero is fully transparent.
layer_contract.brow: Only eyebrow hairs inside two tidy tapered silhouettes. No outer-tail scalp hair, vertical scratch/scar strokes or skin. Preserve at least 4 transparent rows to eye.

front_scalp_envelope_px.purpose: Maximum ordinary frontal scalp silhouette; styles may vary inside the envelope. Cheek-lock lengths below y350 are independent. Rear ornaments/high tie are not scalp and are exempt. Never clip alpha to pass.

ear_attachment_contract_px.skin: Match the corresponding face skin; anatomical root overlaps cheek skin. No floating seam, oversized lobe, detached pixels.
